name: ghost iron
lore_descriptor: translucent silver-blue, almost not all there
first_pickup_chronicle: Ghost iron. Forged in haunted ruins where the dead would not stop walking — the smiths beat them into the metal. A weapon that doesn't pass through what doesn't have a body.
design_notes: Band C unique-flavor rare_metal. Mid mult (1.15), the special is 'phasebound' (can hit incorporeal monsters that would otherwise resist physical attacks). Cannot be blessed — the spirits in the iron don't tolerate it. Fills the Band C unique-flavor gap.
